verses.text: [“] My spirit is destroyed, my days are extinguished—graves are for me.

segments.text: [“] My spirit is destroyed, my days are extinguished—graves are for me.

verses.text: If not, mockers [are] with me, and in their provocation my eye lodges.

segments.text: If not, mockers [are] with me, and in their provocation my eye lodges.

verses.text: Place, please, my pledge with You; who [is] he who will strike himself to my hand?

segments.text: Place, please, my pledge with You; who [is] he who will strike himself to my hand?

verses.text: For You have hidden their heart from understanding, [and] upon thus You will not exalt [them].

segments.text: For You have hidden their heart from understanding, [and] upon thus You will not exalt [them].

verses.text: He reports [his] friends for a portion, and the eyes of his sons are consumed.

segments.text: He reports [his] friends for a portion, and the eyes of his sons are consumed.

verses.text: And He has made me a byword among the peoples, and a spitting in the face I have become.

segments.text: And He has made me a byword among the peoples, and a spitting in the face I have become.

verses.text: And my eye is dim from sorrow, and my members [are] like a shadow, all of them.

segments.text: And my eye is dim from sorrow, and my members [are] like a shadow, all of them.

verses.text: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent rouses himself against the godless.

segments.text: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent rouses himself against the godless.

verses.text: Yet the righteous shall hold to his way, and the one clean of hands shall add strength.

segments.text: Yet the righteous shall hold to his way, and the one clean of hands shall add strength.

verses.text: But all of them, you⁺ should return and come in, please! And I shall not find a wise one among you⁺.

verses.text: My days have passed by, my plans are pulled out—the possessions of my heart.

segments.text: My days have passed by, my plans are pulled out—the possessions of my heart.

verses.text: They set the night into day: ‘Light [is] near in the face of darkness.’

verses.text: If I await Sheol [as] my house, [if] in the darkness I spread out my bed,

verses.text: [if] to the Pit I call out, ‘You are My father,’ or to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister’—
